description: The Akaki archive includes HEC-RAS files, simulation results and geospatial inputs supporting a study of city-scale flood-exposure estimation in Addis Ababa. This resource is provided by Andrew B. Carr and coauthors; University of Leeds. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: It is a study model and supporting data package; execution and transferability were not tested. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
